provenance: Seven user-generated finished positive illustrations explicitly authorized by their owner for public skill examples and visually cross-checked against the original thread summary. Original private photos and negative example images are excluded.
verification_scope: Visual style and positive-reference classification were checked. Original private photos were not available for comparison; identity, clothing, object and scene fidelity to source photos has not been verified.
usage_scope: Use these works as visual style references. Depicted people, objects, text, locations and decorations are example-specific content and must not be copied into unrelated requests.
metadata_review: Each source PNG contains only IHDR, IDAT and IEND chunks, with no trailing data. No embedded text, EXIF or other ancillary metadata was present.
